title: John Norseen at Allagash during 1976 abduction testing subcutaneous tracking device

tellings.quote: He said he was doing a TTR, tag, trace, retrieve exercise with a subcutaneous device that they were testing

plain: In 1976, men in Allagash, Maine, reported being abducted, and one of them says a man named John Norseen told him he had been there at the time, running "a TTR, tag, trace, retrieve exercise with a subcutaneous device that they were testing": a tracking device placed under the skin. The witness, who is not named, relays this on the show as what Norseen told him. If true, part of what happened at Allagash would have been a human test of tracking implants.
